property_summary: For any inputs to initialize, the deployed C contract sets its public feeRate to the provided _feeRate (subject to the existing validation) — the mutant that clamps feeRate to 0 causes feeRate() to differ from the supplied value for some fuzzed _feeRate inputs.
change_summary: Clamp the supplied _feeRate to zero before assignment (force feeRate = 0 regardless of input).
